_doc: Rogueloot Act 1 bestiary (Fable, 2026-11-10). READ docs/BESTIARY.md for the design. NUMBERS: every monster's hp/damage/armour/resists is a MULTIPLIER against the level baseline in `baseline` (1.0 = a normal monster of that level); the sim computes `hp = baseline.hp(level) * mult * players(n)`. `size` is the body's height (bipeds) or length (others) in metres; `speed` in m/s (player walks 4.0, sprint none). `attackRange` in metres. Roles follow PLAN §0 ruling 45. `abilities[].telegraph` is what the client draws on the ground: { shape: circle|cone|line|ring|none, size: metres (radius / length), width: metres for line, warn: seconds the shape is shown before it lands }. `interruptible` casts show a cast bar and stop (with `interruptLock` s of silence) when a player interrupt lands. `counter` is what a player is meant to do. `ai` notes: packSize is [min,max]; `patrol` packs walk a route; `flock` packs steer with separation and cohesion (ruling 16: nobody stacks). `look` is a BUILD SPEC for stylised flat-shaded low-poly geometry (ruling 14 & 24): bodyPlan, proportions as fractions of `size`, parts, 3-4 hex palette (body / secondary / accent / eyes), a silhouette note (what reads at phone scale), and animation notes for idle/attack/death. Names are original and checked against docs/banned-names.md by the assembler (nothing on that list appears anywhere in this file).

baseline._doc: Per-level baseline a role multiplies. Tuned for a 1.5 s GCD and 10-30 s fights: a level-L player with on-level gear does ~ (12 + 6L) damage per GCD; a normal monster dies to ~5-7 of those, a brute to ~9, a swarm body to ~2. Damage is per hit; the sim pays it once per `attackSpeed` seconds.

brute.threat: sticks to the top of its threat table; taunt-able; never retargets to a healer on its own

skirmisher.threat: prefers the LOWEST armour target in reach; breaks off after 2 hits to circle to a flank (ruling 45: kites/flanks)

archer.threat: holds 9-12 m, steps sideways to regain line of sight, backs away from a target under 4 m, prefers the target hurting it most

caster.threat: stands still to cast (cast bar + telegraph), walks only to find range; every big cast is interruptible

shaman.threat: stays behind its pack, buffs/heals on cooldown, never attacks while a pack member is under 50%; the priority kill

leader.threat: rallies the pack (shared buff), flees at 25% hp toward the nearest other pack and calls it (ruling 45); killing it before it runs is the counterplay

swarm.threat: flocks (separation + cohesion), swarms the nearest player, groups of 8-14 (the spawn tables call these swarms); dies to any area attack

tidewrack.name: Tidewrack
tidewrack.fantasy: What the sea leaves on the Saltgrass shore: hard-shelled crabs, leaping shoal fish, gull-things, and the brine-hags that sing them in. Bright shells, wet rock, pale green glow.
tidewrack.teaches: basic brute vs skirmisher; the first shelled enemy you should hit from behind

fieldpest.name: Fieldpest
fieldpest.fantasy: Everything that eats a harvest: grain rats by the dozen, moles that heave the ground up under your feet, wasps in the chaff, and the weevils and moulds of a mill left to rot.
fieldpest.teaches: swarms and flocking; area attacks; a brute that surfaces under you

hollowhorn.name: Hollowhorn Warband
hollowhorn.fantasy: The hill clans under one warlord, Ruhk of the Black Stag. Squat, broad, in horned iron caps and stag-skull paint; raiding the coast for gold and for diggers. They are the game's full 'people' roster: every role, and the first enemies who work as a team.
hollowhorn.teaches: the whole role system (archer line of sight, interruptible caster, shaman priority, leader flight) one piece at a time

beast.name: Wild Beasts
beast.fantasy: Wolves that circle, boars that charge, mountain rams and ridge cats. No tricks: speed, charge, and the question of who the wolves pick first.
beast.teaches: charge telegraphs (a line), flanking skirmishers that target the squishiest player

thornkin.name: Thornkin
thornkin.fantasy: The living wood: bramble-bodied walkers, thistle sprites that cast from above, roots that reach up. Bright moss green and berry red, flowers on the dangerous ones.
thornkin.teaches: poison over time, ground hazards that persist, rooting

creeper.name: Creepers
creeper.fantasy: Spiders and borers of the hollow and the deep mine. Webs that slow, broods that pour out of egg sacs, mandibles.
creeper.teaches: slows, adds from spawners you must kill first, the cocoon rescue mechanic

elderkin.name: Elderkin
elderkin.fantasy: What the elves of Elderglade left behind: wooden wardens that still patrol, oath-bound ghosts in green glass, moon-cantors singing a verse nobody finishes. Dignified, sad, deadly.
elderkin.teaches: storm and frost resists matter; casters with line telegraphs; a caster boss

mirefolk.name: Mirefolk
mirefolk.fantasy: Frog-folk of the fen, leeches in their thousands, the lurkers that look like logs, and the mudwitches who keep them all alive. Yellow-green, wet, foul.
mirefolk.teaches: poison pools that stack, a healer-shaman that must die first, a swarm that is a liquid

restless.name: The Restless
restless.fantasy: The dead of the old kingdom, woken by the digging: husks, rattling archers, floating candle-skulls, shroud-wrapped mothers who stitch the fallen back up, and the reeves and knights that still hold the hills for a king under the ground.
restless.teaches: shadow damage, re-raised adds, the leader that calls the dead

gravesworn.name: The Gravesworn
gravesworn.fantasy: The warband's hired diggers turned into a cult by what they found: hooded, candle-crowned, sworn to the Sealed Lord. They are not warriors; they are the ones who open doors.
gravesworn.teaches: interrupts as the main mechanic; a channel that must be stopped or the room gets worse

stonebound.name: Stonebound
stonebound.fantasy: Constructs of the old kingdom and the frontier: a scarecrow that walks, a mill golem of grindstones, rune-watchers, tide wardens, cairn sentinels dug out of the hillside. Slow, enormous, and the fight is about where you stand.
stonebound.teaches: big telegraphs, armour that rewards magic, immovable brutes

wyrmkin.name: Wyrmkin
wyrmkin.fantasy: Drakes and kites of the high pass: scree drakes that dive, cliff kites that strafe, and the storm-crest wyvern that owns the top of the world.
wyrmkin.teaches: flyers (out of melee until they land), breath cones, a rare you are not ready for yet

abilities.name: Pinch
abilities.effect: basic hit
abilities.counter: none needed

abilities.name: Shell Up
abilities.effect: faces its attacker and takes 60% less damage from the FRONT for 3 s; the back is open
abilities.counter: walk behind it (the first 'hit it from behind' lesson; its eyes-forward pose makes the front obvious)

ai.notes: walks sideways (visible crab-step); slow, so skirmish-y players can kite it forever on purpose. Spawns half-buried in sand and pops up when a player is within 6 m.

look.silhouette: a dome with one huge claw held up; eye stalks tip the player off to which way is 'front'

anim.idle: shell bobs, eye stalks swivel, big claw opens/closes slowly
anim.attack: big claw snaps shut with a 0.2 s pull-back
anim.death: flips onto its back, legs curl, shell tint fades to grey

abilities.name: Bite
abilities.effect: basic hit
abilities.counter: none needed

abilities.name: Flop Leap
abilities.effect: leaps up to 6 m onto a target's spot for 1.3x damage
abilities.counter: step out of the small circle before it lands

ai.notes: flanks after two bites: picks a point 90 degrees round the target and leaps there. Pack of them teaches 'they do not all come from the front'.

proportions.body: fish body 1.0 long on four stubby fin-legs 0.2
proportions.head: 40% of body, mouth hinge

look.silhouette: a fish standing up on fins, mouth open; the dorsal fin is a flag

anim.idle: gulps, fins paddle, body wobbles like it cannot quite stand
anim.attack: whole body lunges, jaw clacks
anim.death: flops twice, lies on its side, fins twitch

abilities.name: Dive Peck
abilities.effect: swoops along a line and pecks the first player on it; lands for 1.5 s afterward (meleeable)
abilities.counter: sidestep the line; hit it in the landed window

abilities.name: Screech
abilities.effect: players in 4 m lose 20% move speed for 3 s
abilities.counter: walk out of the circle

ai.notes: circles at 3 m altitude out of melee reach until Dive Peck; archers and casters can always hit it. Flees to 10 m when under 30% hp, comes back. First flyer: teaches that ranged players have a job.

look.silhouette: wide flat wings, big hooked beak; reads as a seagull drawn angry

anim.idle: glides in a circle, wings beat once a second
anim.attack: folds wings and drops along the line, beak first
anim.death: tumbles, lands in a heap of wing

abilities.name: Shell Slam
abilities.effect: drops its whole shell; 2x damage in 2.5 m and knocks back 2 m
abilities.counter: walk out; the shell raising is the tell

abilities.name: Hunker
abilities.effect: at 40% hp: stops, takes 75% less physical damage for 4 s, takes NORMAL magic damage; storm hits make it flinch (interrupt the hunker)
abilities.counter: swap to spells or storm, or wait it out; first lesson that armour does not stop magic

ai.notes: a mini-boss for the cave floor; sits in a pool and only comes out when touched or attacked. Slowest thing in the game.

parts: bearded face under the shell lip
look.silhouette: a boulder on legs with three white barnacle spikes; nothing else in the cave is that wide

anim.idle: breathes; barnacles do not move (that is the point); drips
anim.attack: rears up to 1.4x height then drops
anim.death: shell cracks along the top (swap to a two-piece shell), legs fold

abilities.name: Brine Bolt
abilities.effect: frost bolt, slows 30% for 2 s
abilities.counter: interrupt or close in; she keeps casting from range

abilities.name: Drowning Song
abilities.effect: channel; every second, players in 5 m take frost damage and the slow stacks (max 3). The FIRST interruptible big cast in the game: the circle is drawn for the whole channel.
abilities.counter: interrupt it (the tutorial for interrupts) or walk out of the circle

ai.notes: sits on a rock with 2-4 tideling crabs; opens with Drowning Song when a player enters 8 m. Backs away from melee once, then stands and casts.

parts: a glowing green pearl held at the chest
look.silhouette: tall and thin with a three-spike crown and hair that drags; the pearl is the only bright spot

anim.idle: sways, hair drifts as if underwater
anim.attack: pearl rises above her head and pulses once per bolt; Drowning Song: arms spread, mouth open, pearl spins
anim.death: she folds into a puddle with the crown and pearl left on top

abilities.name: Clutch
abilities.effect: basic hit
abilities.counter: none needed

abilities.name: Waterlogged
abilities.effect: on death, leaves a 2 m puddle for 6 s that slows 25%
abilities.counter: kill them where you do not need to stand

ai.notes: lies in the shallows; stands up when a player comes within 5 m (0.8 s rise animation during which it cannot be hit for full damage... no: it CAN be hit, the rise is free damage). Slow, relentless, never flees. Foreshadows the Restless.

look.silhouette: a stiff-armed sailor shape with a crab on one shoulder; it is the only humanoid in the caves

anim.idle: sways, water drips from the arms
anim.attack: both arms come down together, slow
anim.death: collapses forward and a puddle spreads

abilities.name: Nip
abilities.effect: basic hit; 5+ rats biting one player add a 'Gnawed' bleed (tiny, 4 s)
abilities.counter: area attacks; keep moving so the ring never closes

ai.notes: THE flocking test case: 8-14 bodies with separation 0.6 m, cohesion to the group centre, all steering at the nearest player. They pour out of grain sacks and hedge lines. A player standing still gets surrounded in ~4 s; walking breaks the ring.

parts: grain husk stuck to the back
look.silhouette: small, fast, many; a wedge with a tail

anim.idle: sniffs, sits up on hind legs, grooms
anim.attack: hops forward and bites
anim.death: pops onto its side with a squeak; no ragdoll (they are many)

abilities.name: Dig Claw
abilities.effect: basic hit
abilities.counter: none needed

abilities.name: Upheaval
abilities.effect: dives underground (untargetable 2 s), a churning dirt circle travels under a player, then it erupts: 2x damage + 1 s knock-up
abilities.counter: walk off the dirt circle; it erupts where the circle stops, so keep moving

ai.notes: starts underground; a mound in the field with a dust puff is the spawn marker. Immune to damage while burrowed, so it is a tank check nobody can skip.

look.silhouette: a barrel with two shovels in front; the pink star nose is the face

anim.idle: sniffs with the star nose, claws scrape
anim.attack: claws dig alternately; Upheaval: dives nose-first, pops up with a dirt burst
anim.death: rolls onto its back, claws up

abilities.name: Sting
abilities.effect: poison hit; 3 stacks = 'Stung' poison over 6 s
abilities.counter: kill them fast; they die to one or two hits

abilities.name: Dart Away
abilities.effect: after a sting, zips 4 m to a random side and comes back
abilities.counter: area attacks or ranged; melee players learn to wait for it to come to them

ai.notes: low flyer (1.2 m), so melee CAN hit it unlike the gullhawk. Erratic steering: sine-wave jitter on its path.

look.silhouette: a striped bead with two transparent discs; yellow/black reads 'do not touch'

anim.idle: hovers in a figure-eight, wing discs spin
anim.attack: dips and jabs the stinger forward
anim.death: wing discs stop (swap to folded wings), drops

abilities.name: Snout Jab
abilities.effect: basic hit
abilities.counter: none needed

abilities.name: Bore
abilities.effect: snout drill: 'Bored' -15% armour for 8 s (stacks twice); the weevil then scurries to a flank
abilities.counter: face it; sidestep the short cone

ai.notes: runs along walls and barrels rather than open floor (flow field prefers edges, a cosmetic weight). Groups go for whoever has the lowest armour.

look.silhouette: an oval with a long needle nose; flour-white top

anim.idle: snout probes the ground, antennae tap
anim.attack: snout stabs forward; Bore: snout spins like a drill
anim.death: legs fold under, flips

abilities.name: Spore Puff
abilities.effect: lobbed spore ball, poison over 4 s
abilities.counter: interrupt or burn it (fire weakness)

abilities.name: Bloom
abilities.effect: a mould patch under a player's feet that lasts 10 s: poison per second and heals fieldpests standing in it
abilities.counter: interrupt it; or fight away from the patch (it is the first PERSISTENT ground hazard)

ai.notes: a pile of grain gone wrong that stood up. Does not chase; roots itself to cast; waddles to a new spot if nobody is in range.

proportions.body: 1.5 tall heap, wider at the base

look.silhouette: a heap with four mushroom caps for hair; wider than tall

anim.idle: slow breathing swell, spore motes drift
anim.attack: hunches and 'coughs' a spore ball; Bloom: spreads both lumps wide and shakes
anim.death: deflates into a flat mat, caps topple

abilities.name: Axe Chop
abilities.effect: basic hit
abilities.counter: none needed

abilities.name: Shield Shove
abilities.effect: knocks the target back 3 m and interrupts THEIR cast (the enemies can interrupt you too)
abilities.counter: do not cast long spells in its face; sidestep the cone

abilities.name: Raider's Shout
abilities.effect: when a packmate dies: +15% damage for 8 s (they get angrier, not weaker)
abilities.counter: kill the raiders LAST if there is a slinger or hexer in the pack

ai.notes: THE baseline enemy. Scales across six zones; the look changes by level band (see look.tiers). Walks straight at the top threat; swaps to a player who hits it from behind only if that player passes it on threat.

parts: round shield with a stag-skull daub
look.silhouette: short, wide, two horns and a round shield; the shield is the thing you walk around

tiers.7-12: mail shirt, both horns, red cloak scrap
tiers.13-17: plate pauldron, horns bound in red cord, a second axe on the belt

anim.idle: shifts weight, thumps axe on shield
anim.attack: overhand chop; Shove: shield comes up and lunges
anim.death: drops to a knee, falls sideways, cap rolls off

abilities.name: Sling Stone
abilities.effect: a stone that can be dodged by the hit check and BLOCKED by line of sight (rocks, trees)
abilities.counter: break line of sight; it must walk to find you again, which drags it into melee

abilities.name: Lead Shot
abilities.effect: a heavy shot down a drawn line: 2x damage, 1 s daze
abilities.counter: step off the line

ai.notes: holds 9-12 m; if the target closes under 4 m it backs off ONCE (3 m) then fights in melee at 0.5x damage. Picks the player hurting it most. Stands on high ground when the zone has any (spawn markers tag 'perch').

look.silhouette: the thin one with one horn and a whirling arm

anim.idle: swings the sling lazily, scans
anim.attack: two overhead whirls then release; Lead Shot: four whirls, visibly slower
anim.death: drops the sling, sits down, slumps

abilities.name: Knife
abilities.effect: basic hit; from BEHIND the target it is 1.5x
abilities.counter: turn to face it; it circles

abilities.name: Hamstring
abilities.effect: target -40% move speed for 3 s (sets up the pack)
abilities.counter: cleanse or outlast; kill cutthroats before the brutes arrive

abilities.name: Smoke Pinch
abilities.effect: at 35% hp: drops a smoke puff, untargetable 1.5 s, reappears 5 m to a flank
abilities.counter: area attacks hit it in the smoke; or ignore it and it comes back to you

ai.notes: circles to the target's back (steers to the point behind them, re-picks every 1.5 s); ALWAYS picks the lowest-armour player in 12 m. Hides behind raiders until they engage. The skirmisher lesson: protect your caster.

parts: hooded head with two short horns poking through
look.silhouette: dark, crouched, two blades out to the sides; horns through the hood

anim.idle: crouch, knives flick
anim.attack: quick double slash
anim.death: spins once, falls on its face

abilities.name: Cinder Spit
abilities.effect: weak fire bolt (filler)
abilities.counter: ignore; kill it

abilities.name: Bone Rattle
abilities.effect: every Hollowhorn in 8 m: +25% attack speed for 10 s; a red glow on their horns shows who is buffed
abilities.counter: interrupt it, or kill the chanter first (its horns glow while it casts)

abilities.name: Ash Salve
abilities.effect: heals the lowest packmate for 25% of its hp
abilities.counter: interrupt; the FIRST enemy healer, teaches 'shaman first'

ai.notes: stays 5-7 m behind the pack's centre; when a player comes at it, the nearest raider is told to Shield Shove them (pack coordination hook `defendShaman`). Never leaves the pack's leash.

parts: full stag skull worn as a helm (antlers 0.5 wide)
rattle staff with a skull on top
look.silhouette: the antlers: twice as wide as any other Hollowhorn head

anim.idle: shakes the rattle, stamps
anim.attack: stamps the staff; Bone Rattle: raises the staff and the antlers glow red; Ash Salve: kneels and blows ash at the target
anim.death: the skull helm falls off first, then the body

abilities.name: Boar Spear
abilities.effect: basic hit at 1.8 m
abilities.counter: none needed

abilities.name: Rally the Clan
abilities.effect: horn blast: the pack +20% damage and immune to fear/slow for 8 s, and the pack regroups on the warcaller
abilities.counter: interrupt; or spread the pack so the ring misses half of them

abilities.name: Call for Aid
abilities.effect: at 25% hp: drops a smoke flare and RUNS at 5.2 m/s toward the nearest other Hollowhorn pack within 40 m; if it reaches them, that pack comes (ruling 45). If no pack is in range, it fights on.
abilities.counter: slow, root or burst it when the flare drops; the flare is the tell; a player who stuns it wins the fight outright

ai.notes: the pack's anchor: raiders stand within 6 m of it. When the warcaller dies, the remaining pack gets 'Leaderless' (-15% damage, cutthroats flee at 50%). On the King's Road, warcaller packs PATROL the road between camps, so the fleeing one usually has somewhere to go.

parts: tall horned helm with a red plume
a war horn on a strap
stag-skull banner pole on the back (small, 1.2 m)
look.silhouette: tallest Hollowhorn, the banner pole on the back and a plume: you see it over the pack

anim.idle: leans on the spear, horn at the hip
anim.attack: two-handed thrust; Rally: horn to the mouth, head back
anim.flee: spear dropped, one arm pumping, a smoke flare in the other hand
anim.death: falls backward, banner pole snaps (swap to a broken pole)

abilities.name: Bite
abilities.effect: basic hit
abilities.counter: none needed

abilities.name: Drag Down
abilities.effect: pounce; target is pinned 1.5 s (cannot move; can still cast) and bleeds
abilities.counter: step out before the pounce lands; a friend hitting the hound breaks the pin early

ai.notes: runs ahead of a Hollowhorn pack by 5 m (sight-hound: engages first, the pack follows its target). Picks the player FURTHEST from the pack: it is there to pull stragglers in.

look.silhouette: a running dog with a thick collar; the collar is what says 'warband'

anim.idle: paces, nose down
anim.attack: snap; Drag Down: leap with front legs out
anim.death: skids, lies on its side

abilities.name: Bite
abilities.effect: basic hit; wolves biting the same target within 2 s add +20% each (pack bite)
abilities.counter: do not stand still; the pack punishes the one who does

abilities.name: Howl
abilities.effect: the first wolf to see a player howls: the pack converges and gets +20% speed for 6 s
abilities.counter: interrupt it or burst the howler; it stands still to howl

ai.notes: the pack's CIRCLE: wolves hold a 4 m ring around the target, one darts in at a time (token system: `attackSlots` 2), the rest circle. The lowest-armour player is the pick. Wolves flee at 20% hp and come back when the pack re-engages.

look.silhouette: a wolf with hackle tufts; stripes read even at phone scale

anim.idle: circles slowly, head low
anim.attack: lunge and snap; Howl: sits, head to the sky
anim.death: tumbles, lies on its side

abilities.name: Gore
abilities.effect: basic hit
abilities.counter: none needed

abilities.name: Charge
abilities.effect: paws the ground, then runs the line at 9 m/s: 2x damage + knockdown 1 s to anyone on it; stops at the end or on a wall (0.8 s stun on the boar if it hits a wall)
abilities.counter: sidestep the line; stand so the line ends in a tree and it stuns itself (the charge-into-wall reward)

ai.notes: roots in a clearing with 1-2 others; attacks the first player it sees and does not swap. Re-charges whenever its target is 5+ m away.

parts: a mane of root tendrils down the spine
look.silhouette: a barrel with tusks and a green root-mane

anim.idle: snuffles the ground, shakes
anim.attack: head toss; Charge: paws twice, then full gallop
anim.death: topples sideways with legs out

abilities.name: Web Shot
abilities.effect: a web glob: light damage, -30% move speed 2 s
abilities.counter: break line of sight behind trees; it climbs for a new angle

abilities.name: Snare Line
abilities.effect: lays a web strip that lasts 12 s: players crossing it are rooted 1.5 s
abilities.counter: do not cross the white strip; the strip is drawn as geometry so you can see it

ai.notes: hangs on trees (spawn tag 'perch' at 2.5 m height; climbs down when its target is under 3 m). Fires Snare Line BETWEEN the players and itself.

parts: round abdomen with a pale hourglass
look.silhouette: a ball on eight high knees; the yellow hourglass tells it apart from the burrow spider

anim.idle: legs tap in pairs, abdomen bobs
anim.attack: turns its back and flicks the abdomen (shoots from the rear)
anim.death: legs curl under, drops

abilities.name: Thorn Lash
abilities.effect: basic hit + 'Scratched' poison over 4 s
abilities.counter: none needed; cleanse the poison

abilities.name: Thorned Hide
abilities.effect: melee hits on it reflect 10% of the damage dealt back as poison
abilities.counter: ranged and fire; a melee player can still kill it but feels it (teaches the Thorned champion modifier later)

abilities.name: Root Grasp
abilities.effect: roots burst under a player: rooted 2 s and the wight walks to them
abilities.counter: walk out of the circle

ai.notes: stands as a bush until a player is within 4 m (idle = a bush, no health bar). Slow; players can outwalk it, which is the point: the brute you kite is a different fight from the brute you tank.

parts: a sapling growing from the shoulder
look.silhouette: a walking bush with arms too long for it; the red berries are the eyes

anim.idle: (bush form) nothing; (woken) sways, thorns rattle
anim.attack: long overhand sweep; Root Grasp: stamps and roots shoot forward
anim.death: unravels into a pile of sticks

abilities.name: Fangs
abilities.effect: poison hit
abilities.counter: none needed

abilities.name: Trapdoor
abilities.effect: starts hidden in a lid in the floor (a slightly raised disc); bursts out when a player steps within 2 m for 2x damage and a 1 s daze
abilities.counter: watch the floor for raised discs; attack the disc to force it out early (it takes 1 hit to open)

abilities.name: Venom Spray
abilities.effect: poison over 6 s to everyone in the cone
abilities.counter: step to its side

ai.notes: a lurker; after the trapdoor it fights like a brute. Floor discs are placed by the dungeon generator at corridor pinches.

parts: a dirt-crusted lid carried on the back
look.silhouette: wide, low and brown-backed; nothing like the ball-on-stilts spinner

anim.idle: (hidden) a disc; (out) legs shuffle
anim.attack: rears and bites down; Spray: lifts the front legs and sprays
anim.death: flips, legs curl

abilities.name: Nibble
abilities.effect: tiny poison hit; 6+ on one player = 'Swarmed' (-30% move speed)
abilities.counter: area attacks; break the egg sacs before they hatch

ai.notes: hatch from egg sacs (a 'spawner' prop with 1 hp bar: 8 spiderlings in one burst if it is popped by damage, 12 over 10 s if left alone). Pure flock; they climb walls (ignore the walk grid's wall cost at 0.5 speed).

look.silhouette: many small purple dots that move together

anim.idle: skitters in place
anim.attack: hop
anim.death: pop (no ragdoll; a particle)

abilities.name: Needle Volley
abilities.effect: three thistle needles, poison
abilities.counter: interrupt; or wait for it to drop low to cast

abilities.name: Pollen Cloud
abilities.effect: a cloud that lasts 8 s: players inside have their spells cost +50% and melee swings miss 20% more (coughing)
abilities.counter: interrupt or leave the cloud

abilities.name: Flit
abilities.effect: when hit by melee: darts 5 m away at 1.8 m altitude (out of melee reach for 2 s), then lowers to cast
abilities.counter: ranged players; or bait the flit and chase

ai.notes: hovers at 1.8 m while moving, drops to 1.0 m (meleeable) to cast. Giggles (a sound cue) 0.5 s before Pollen Cloud.

proportions.body: 0.4 thistle head on a 0.3 stem body

parts: thin stem body with two leaf arms
two bright eyes in the thistle
look.silhouette: a purple puff on leaf wings; the only purple thing in the glade

anim.idle: bobs, wings flutter, spins slowly
anim.attack: shakes its head and needles fly; Pollen Cloud: spins fast and sheds motes
anim.death: wings fold, falls, puffs into seeds

abilities.name: Limb Swing
abilities.effect: basic hit
abilities.counter: none needed

abilities.name: Ward Stomp
abilities.effect: a RING 1.5-4 m out: 1.8x damage and knockdown. Standing right against it, or 4+ m away, is safe
abilities.counter: hug it or back off; the ring is the first 'donut' telegraph

abilities.name: Oath Bind
abilities.effect: forces a player to attack IT for 3 s (an enemy taunt); the target is tethered by a green vine
abilities.counter: interrupt; or break the tether by moving 8 m away

champions._doc: D2-style champion/elite packs. A champion pack = one monster type's pack with 1-3 modifiers rolled from this table (weights below), the whole pack shares them (the 'pack' flag) or only the champion carries them (the 'solo' flag), the champion is 1.3x size, has a coloured name plate and hp x3 / damage x1.4 / xp x4 / guaranteed magic+ drop. Roll count by area level: 1-7 one mod, 8-14 two, 15-20 three. Mods listed with `excludes` never roll together. Every mod has a TELL (visible on the body before the fight), a RULE (the sim), and COUNTERPLAY (what the player does).

thorned.name: Thorned
thorned.tell: spines sprout from the body (a ring of 8 cones), tinted green
thorned.rule: reflects 20% of melee damage taken back to the attacker as poison
thorned.counter: ranged, spells, or accept the trade and heal through it; never auto-attack it while low

hasted.name: Hasted
hasted.tell: yellow speed lines trail the body; animations play 1.3x
hasted.counter: slows and roots; kill the shaman/caster first since they cast faster too

brawny.name: Brawny
brawny.counter: the plain stat check; kite and whittle

stonehide.name: Stonehide
stonehide.tell: grey rock plates on the shoulders and back
stonehide.rule: +100% armour, physical damage taken -30%; magic normal
stonehide.counter: spells and elemental weapons; the mage's time to shine

burning.name: Burning
burning.tell: the champion is on fire (flame particles, orange rim light); leaves scorched footprints
burning.rule: leaves a fire trail (2 s per step) and its hits add a 3 s burn
burning.counter: fight where it has not walked; fire resist; kite it in a circle so the trail is behind you

rimed.name: Rimed
rimed.tell: ice crystals on the body, frost mist at the feet, blue tint
rimed.rule: hits slow 30% for 3 s (stacks to 60%); on death: a 3 m frost burst
rimed.counter: frost resist; do not stack slows by standing in it; step back when it dies

stormtouched.name: Stormtouched
stormtouched.tell: arcs of lightning jump between its horns/hands every second; a crackle sound
stormtouched.rule: every 3rd hit chains storm damage to all players within 4 m of the target

venomous.name: Venomous
venomous.tell: green drips from the mouth/weapon, green eye glow
venomous.rule: hits add a stacking poison (max 5); on death the body leaves a 2.5 m poison pool for 8 s
venomous.counter: cleanse, poison resist, kill it where you do not need to stand

shrouded.name: Shrouded
shrouded.tell: a dark smoke cloak, the name plate is purple, nearby lights dim
shrouded.rule: its hits heal it for 30% of damage dealt; players within 3 m lose 2% max hp a second (shadow)
shrouded.counter: burst it; fight it at range; shadow resist

warded.name: Warded
warded.tell: a visible bubble (a translucent sphere) with a number on it
warded.rule: a shield absorbing 50% of its max hp must be broken before it takes damage; the shield regenerates fully if it takes no damage for 6 s
warded.counter: everyone on the same target; do not split damage across the pack

summoning.name: Summoning
summoning.tell: a floating rune circle over its head; small 'gates' open at its feet
summoning.rule: every 8 s spawns 2 swarm-role bodies of its family (rats, spiderlings, leeches; husks for Restless at 0.5 hp) that die when it dies
summoning.counter: kill the champion, ignore the adds, or area them while they are grouped

shifting.name: Shifting
shifting.tell: the body flickers (double image), purple sparkle
shifting.rule: when it takes 15% of its hp in 2 s, it shifts 6 m to a random side (max once per 5 s)
shifting.counter: cooldowns after the shift; melee stand ready to move; roots stop the shift

leeching.name: Leeching
leeching.tell: red veins on the body, a heartbeat pulse in the tint
leeching.rule: the pack heals 25% of damage it deals; the champion heals 50%
leeching.counter: burst damage beats sustained; interrupt their damage with stuns; healers out-heal it

cursing.name: Cursing
cursing.tell: a black halo of runes orbits the head
cursing.rule: every 10 s curses the top threat: 'Hexed' -20% damage dealt and healing received for 8 s (a cleansable debuff)
cursing.counter: cleanse; or trade: hexed players swap to interrupting and others do the damage

volatile.name: Volatile
volatile.tell: the body glows from inside, orange cracks, a tick sound when it is under 20% hp
volatile.rule: on death, bursts after 1.2 s for fire damage in 3 m (2x normal hit)
volatile.counter: step away as each dies; ranged kills; fire resist

anchored.name: Anchored
anchored.tell: chains hang from the body and trail on the floor; a stone weight tint
anchored.rule: immune to knockback/pull/slow; every 12 s pulls all players within 10 m 5 m toward it
anchored.counter: stand 10+ m or hug it; the pull is a cast with a 1 s wind-up you can see

hale.name: Hale
hale.tell: gold rim light, a slow pulse
hale.rule: regenerates 3% max hp a second out of combat and 1% in combat; the pack keeps fighting after the champion dies (no Leaderless)
hale.counter: commit; never let it reset; finish the fight you start

twinned.name: Twinned
twinned.tell: two champions with the same name and a 'II' plate; they share one health bar
twinned.rule: two champions, one shared hp pool (x4 instead of x3); they take 15% less damage while within 5 m of each other
twinned.counter: split them with kiting; one player on each

rares._doc: Named rare monsters: ONE spawn point each, 35% chance to be up per session (ruling 25: fresh each game), own name plate (gold), hp x5 / damage x1.5 / xp x8 of their base type, 1-2 fixed modifiers plus ONE random, a guaranteed rare+ drop and a chance at their own unique (see data/uniques.json names when they are made: a rare's `uniqueHint` says what kind). A rare uses its base type's abilities plus one `signature`.

the_lamplighter.name: The Lamplighter

the_lamplighter.look: gravecandle at 1.6x with nine candles in a crown; its light is three times the radius

velka_thricewed.name: Velka Thricewed

velka_thricewed.look: cantor with three crescent crowns stacked and three veils of mist

bogmother_sulk.name: Bogmother Sulk

signature.name: Rising Fen

signature.counter: interrupt; fight her from the boardwalk (higher ground is not flooded)

bogmother_sulk.lore: The mudwitches' matriarch. She sulks in the deepest pool and the fen rises when she stands.
bogmother_sulk.look: mudwitch at 1.6x on a throne of leeches, a crown of mire lights

hoarfang.name: Hoarfang

signature.name: Double Pounce
signature.effect: pounces one player, then a second within 1 s
signature.counter: stay in pairs; stuns on the first landing

hoarfang.lore: A white lynx the ramherds say is winter itself come down to eat.
hoarfang.look: ridge_lynx at 1.5x, pure white, frost breath, a torn ear

captain_vosk.name: Captain Vosk the Burned

signature.name: Pot Barrage
signature.effect: six firepots land in six circles across the area
signature.counter: walk between them; it is a dodging puzzle

captain_vosk.lore: Ruhk's sapper captain, who lost half his face to his own powder and swears the other half is next.
captain_vosk.look: sapper at 1.4x with half the face a burn scar, a bandolier of pots, a brass goggle on the good eye

the_kept_bride.name: The Kept Bride

signature.name: The Vow
signature.effect: binds one player to her: they cannot move more than 6 m from her for 6 s
signature.counter: interrupt; the bound player attacks her anyway

the_kept_bride.lore: Drowned on her wedding day when the sea took the ruins. She is still waiting at the altar.
the_kept_bride.look: drowned_shade at 1.3x in a trailing white gown of water, a wreath of kelp, a ring held out

morrow_the_unburied.name: Morrow the Unburied

signature.name: The King's Due
signature.effect: a channel; every second a Barrow Husk rises in the circle (max 5)
signature.counter: interrupt; or burn the field before he starts

morrow_the_unburied.lore: The last knight to swear to the Sealed Lord, and the only one who was never put in the ground.
morrow_the_unburied.look: ossuary_knight at 1.4x with a full crowned helm, a cloak of ledger pages, a greatblade twice its size

bosses._doc: Unique bosses, one per dungeon (ruling 46: 2-3 phases, 2-4 readable mechanics). hp/damage are multipliers against the baseline at the boss's level (a boss is ~12-20 normal monsters of hp). `phases[].at` is the hp fraction the phase starts at. `enrage` is seconds from pull: past it the boss does +100% damage (soft enrage: a party that cannot kill it in time is meant to wipe, not grind). `scaling` is per player count [1,2,3,4] and multiplies hp; damage follows baseline.playersScaling. `loot` is the fixed table on top of personal drops. `arena` is for the zone editor.

clatterjaw.name: Clatterjaw
clatterjaw.title: the Pool Tyrant
clatterjaw.arena: a round tide pool 24 m across, knee-deep water in the middle (slows 15%), a dry rim 4 m wide, four rock pillars (line of sight for nobody; they are just for the crabs to spawn behind)

phases.name: The Claw
phases.notes: learn the two telegraphs with nothing else going on

phases.name: The Brood
phases.notes: adds every 25 s; the slam now also knocks back into the water

phases.name: Cracked Shell
phases.notes: the shell is broken (armour 0.6): it hits faster and takes more

claw_slam.name: Claw Slam
claw_slam.effect: 2.5x damage + knockback 4 m (into the water in phase 2)
claw_slam.counter: step out of the cone; it faces the top threat, so the tank points it away from the group

scuttle.name: Scuttle
scuttle.effect: runs sideways down the line (crab-wise) for 1.5x to anyone on it, ends against the rim and is dazed 2 s (free damage)
scuttle.counter: step off the line; hit it in the daze

call_the_tide.name: Call the Tide
call_the_tide.effect: 4 tideling crabs scuttle out from behind the pillars; the boss takes 30% less damage while 3+ live
call_the_tide.counter: interrupt (the first boss teaches that a boss cast can be stopped), or area the crabs quickly

frenzy.name: Frenzy
frenzy.counter: burn it; this is the finish

loot.notes: unique: a shield 'Clatterjaw's Carapace' (block from the front, see uniques.json)

parts: a huge domed shell with a cracked ridge
three harpoons stuck in the shell
barnacles and a fisher's net draped over it
look.silhouette: a boulder with one claw raised like a flag; the harpoons make it unmistakable

anim.idle: shell rises and falls, water runs off
anim.attack: Claw Slam: the big claw rises for the whole wind-up and drops; Scuttle: legs blur sideways

anim.death: the big claw drops, it sinks into the pool, bubbles

gristmaul.name: Gristmaul
gristmaul.title: the Mill That Walks
gristmaul.arena: the mill's round stone floor 20 m across, the great axle in the centre (a 2 m pillar that blocks line of sight and that the boss walks around), four grain chutes in the walls (rat spawns), flour drifts on the floor

phases.name: Dust
phases.notes: the cloud + the rats together: area attacks in the cloud miss, so you must step out to clear the rats

phases.name: Runaway
phases.notes: the wheel comes off: a rolling hazard round the room

millstone_spin.name: Millstone Spin
millstone_spin.effect: the stone body spins: 2x to everyone in the 2.5-6 m ring; inside 2.5 m (hugging it) and beyond 6 m is safe
millstone_spin.counter: hug or back off (the donut, taught by the glade warden later but shown here first)

crush.name: Crush
crush.effect: the millstone arm comes down: 2.5x + 1.5 s knockdown

flour_cloud.name: Flour Cloud
flour_cloud.effect: a white cloud for 10 s: players inside have 40% of attacks miss and cannot see telegraphs beyond 3 m
flour_cloud.counter: interrupt, or leave the cloud (it is cast on the boss, so step away from it)

rats_in_the_walls.name: Rats in the Walls
rats_in_the_walls.effect: 8 grain rats pour from one random chute
rats_in_the_walls.counter: area attack them at the chute as they come out in a line

runaway_wheel.name: Runaway Wheel
runaway_wheel.effect: a stone wheel rolls down the line, bounces off the wall once and rolls back: 2x + knockdown
runaway_wheel.counter: step off the line twice (it comes back)

proportions.arms: one great millstone-arm 2.0, one wooden gear-arm 1.5
proportions.legs: the axle split into two stumpy legs

parts: two stacked millstones for a body
an axle for a spine with iron bands
one millstone on an arm (the hammer)
a sack-cloth 'face' with two glowing holes
rope and a grain hopper on the back
look.silhouette: a stack of discs with one disc held up; flour streams

anim.idle: the stones grind against each other (a slow turn), flour falls
anim.attack: Crush: the arm millstone rises and drops; Spin: the body stones turn fast
anim.death: the stones split apart and the axle falls

mother_thrum.name: Mother Thrum
mother_thrum.title: the Brood Below
mother_thrum.arena: a web-floored cavern 26 x 18 m, six egg sacs round the walls (spawner props, breakable), a ceiling she climbs into (she is untargetable up there), two web-wall 'doors' that seal the exits

phases.name: The Hatching
phases.notes: she climbs to the ceiling for 12 s while the sacs hatch; break the sacs BEFORE this phase and the hatching is small

phases.name: Thrum
phases.notes: she drums the web: the whole floor pulses

web_lines.name: Web Lines
web_lines.effect: three web strips across the room for 12 s: crossing one roots you 1.5 s; they are geometry
web_lines.counter: do not cross; note where they are before cocoon

cocoon.name: Cocoon
cocoon.effect: wraps the player furthest from her: they are helpless in a cocoon (a prop with 5 hits of hp) until a FRIEND breaks it; solo, the cocoon lasts 4 s and breaks on its own with the player at -20% hp
cocoon.counter: interrupt; in co-op, break your friend out (the rescue mechanic); solo it is a damage race

hatch.name: Hatch
hatch.effect: every unbroken egg sac bursts: 6 spiderlings each; she is on the ceiling for 12 s
hatch.counter: break sacs in phase 1 while she is slow to reach you (each has 4 hits)

thrum.name: Thrum
thrum.effect: she drums: a ring expands from her at 4 m/s; anyone it passes through is knocked down 1.5 s and takes 1.5x; jumping is not a thing, so you must be on a web line (which absorbs it) or interrupt
thrum.counter: interrupt; or stand ON a web line (the only time a web is good for you)

loot.notes: unique: 'Thrum's Silk' (chest: poison resist + slow immunity)

proportions.head: small with 8 eyes and two fangs

parts: a huge pale abdomen with a dark hourglass
eight long legs with joints that light
a small head, eight yellow eyes
a crown of dead sprites' wings stuck to her
a web train trailing from the abdomen
look.silhouette: the legs are taller than a player; she is a ceiling of legs

anim.idle: legs tap in a rolling wave; abdomen pulses
anim.attack: fangs lunge; Web Lines: she turns and the abdomen flicks three times; Cocoon: she spins the victim; Thrum: she raises all eight legs and drops them at once
anim.phase2: climbs the wall to the ceiling in 1 s
anim.death: legs curl in slowly, she drops the last metre

reeve_oswin.name: Reeve Oswin
reeve_oswin.title: the Unburied Clerk
reeve_oswin.arena: the barrow's hall of records: a long hall 30 x 16 m with twelve stone coffins in two rows (the adds' spawn points and line-of-sight blockers), a dais with his ledger-lectern at the far end, braziers that can be lit (interact) to burn corpses in 3 m

phases.name: The Ledger
phases.notes: learn the pit telegraph; the first Read raises 2 husks

phases.name: The Roll Call
phases.notes: he chains one player to a coffin; the Read now raises 3 husks and they come back if not burned

phases.name: Audit
phases.notes: the big interruptible cast: one Death Knell per 20 s; two un-interrupted knells wipe a group

grave_pit.name: Grave Pit
grave_pit.effect: the floor opens under a player for 1.5x shadow + 'Buried' (rooted 2 s, -50% healing received)

read_the_names.name: Read the Names
read_the_names.effect: he reads from the ledger: 2 (phase 1) / 3 (phase 2) barrow husks rise from the coffins nearest the players; corpses left on the floor rise again on the next Read unless burned at a brazier
read_the_names.counter: interrupt; or burn the bodies (drag the fight to a brazier); the coffins glow before they open, so you know where

chain_of_office.name: Chain of Office
chain_of_office.effect: a chain flies down the line and shackles the first player to the nearest coffin for 6 s (6 m tether); the coffin has 6 hits of hp
chain_of_office.counter: sidestep the line; a friend breaks the coffin

death_knell.name: Death Knell
death_knell.effect: a 5 s cast; if it finishes, every player takes 4x shadow and every corpse in the hall rises
death_knell.counter: INTERRUPT. If nobody can interrupt, stand behind a coffin (line of sight blocks it, a rule the hall's coffins exist for) and pop a defensive

loot.notes: unique: 'Oswin's Ledger' (off-hand book; spell power + a chance to raise a skeletal helper)

parts: a tall skeleton in a reeve's robe with a chain of office
a tall cylinder cap with a crown band
a rod of office with a sealed-door head
a great ledger chained to his belt
quill fingers on the left hand
blue flame eyes, a jaw bound shut with gold wire
look.silhouette: the tall cap, the ledger, the rod; a clerk, not a knight

anim.idle: turns a page, taps the rod
anim.attack: rod strike; Grave Pit: rod to the floor; Read: lifts the ledger and reads with a pointing finger; Chain: hurls the chain of office; Knell: both arms up, ledger open, light pours from it
anim.death: he closes the ledger, sits on the dais step, and crumbles

ildreth.name: Ildreth
ildreth.title: the Wilted Verse
ildreth.arena: the heart of the roots: a round chamber 22 m across with a moon-well in the centre (a 4 m pool she stands over, out of melee reach: she is a CASTER boss), four root pillars that rise and fall (line-of-sight blockers that move), a ring of moon-marked flagstones at the rim

phases.name: First Verse
phases.notes: she floats over the well; melee cannot reach her until a root pillar is broken and falls as a bridge (each pillar has 8 hits; breaking one lets melee reach her for 15 s)

phases.name: Second Verse
phases.notes: root walls cut the room; she comes down to the floor and walks (meleeable), the pillars are gone

phases.name: Last Verse
phases.notes: ONE mechanic: a 10 s channel that must be interrupted, and she is immune to interrupts for 3 s after each interrupt, so a group needs two interrupters or one with a short cooldown; solo, the channel is 6 s and one interrupt ends the fight's danger

moon_lance.name: Moon Lance
moon_lance.effect: storm bolt at the top threat
moon_lance.counter: interrupt when nothing bigger is coming

moonbeam_cross.name: Moonbeam Cross
moonbeam_cross.effect: a cross of beams through the room that rotates 45 degrees between casts: 2.5x storm + 1 s stun

sprites.name: Seedfall
sprites.effect: 2 thistle sprites drop from the roots; their Pollen Cloud is the real threat (spell cost +50%)
sprites.counter: interrupt; kill sprites before the next cross

root_wall.name: Root Wall
root_wall.effect: a wall of root rises along the line for 12 s (walk-grid wall; fire burns a gap in 3 hits); it splits the party
root_wall.counter: stand on her side of the line, or burn through

last_verse.name: The Last Verse
last_verse.effect: a 10 s channel (6 s solo); if it finishes, 6x storm to everyone and she heals 20%. Each interrupt stops it and she is interrupt-immune 3 s, then may start again on cooldown
last_verse.counter: interrupt; two interrupters alternate; she goes to the floor and is meleeable for the whole channel

loot.notes: unique: 'Ildreth's Crescent' (head; storm resist + interrupt cooldown reduction)

parts: a tall elven ghost in a wilted robe (petals falling from it)
a crescent crown, one horn of the crescent broken
a floating open book with torn pages
look.silhouette: a tall crowned figure over a pool; petals fall from her

anim.idle: floats, pages turn, petals fall
anim.attack: hand flick; Cross: both arms out and the room lights; Root Wall: she drops a hand and roots rise; Last Verse: head back, arms wide, the book spins
anim.phase2: she lowers to the floor and the pillars collapse
anim.death: the book closes, she bows, and goes to motes from the hem up

sister_vennel.name: Sister Vennel
sister_vennel.title: Keeper of the Drowned Bell
sister_vennel.arena: the bell chamber: a square 22 m hall half-flooded (the east half is knee-deep water that slows 15% and where the leeches live), a great bronze bell hung in the centre on a frame, four candle sconces at the corners (interact to light: a lit sconce burns corpses in 4 m and keeps the dark away in phase 3)

phases.name: The Toll
phases.notes: the bell: a 4 s interruptible cast that stuns everyone in the hall for 3 s if it finishes, and the husks all get up; she walks to the bell to ring it (a 3 s walk you can see coming)

phases.name: Lights Out
phases.notes: the hall goes dark except lit sconces and candle rings; she is faster; keep the sconces lit

candle_ring.name: Candle Ring
candle_ring.effect: a ring of fire 3-5 m out round a player for 8 s; crossing burns
candle_ring.counter: decide in or out before it lights; interrupt

husks_from_the_water.name: Husks from the Water
husks_from_the_water.effect: 3 sludge husks wade out of the flooded half (they burst on death, so kill them in the water, away from the group)
husks_from_the_water.counter: kill them on the water's edge; ranged

toll_the_bell.name: Toll the Bell
toll_the_bell.effect: she rings the bell: everyone stunned 3 s, every husk corpse in the hall rises; while stunned, husks hit for 1.5x
toll_the_bell.counter: interrupt (she walks to the bell first: 3 s warning); or stand at a lit sconce, which halves the stun

drowning_dark.name: Drowning Dark
drowning_dark.effect: the hall is dark; players outside a lit sconce's 4 m or a candle ring lose 3% hp a second (shadow) and cannot see telegraphs beyond 4 m; she has +25% speed
drowning_dark.counter: light the four sconces (interact, 1.5 s each); fight her in the light; a candle ring she casts is now a GOOD place to stand

loot.notes: unique: 'Vennel's Key' (wand; shadow damage + interrupt lockout extended)

proportions.head: 0.3 hooded with a crown of 7 candles

parts: a dark Gravesworn robe with a gold bell sigil
a long bronze key (1 m) held in both hands
a small hand-bell on the belt
wax running down the whole robe
look.silhouette: the seven-candle crown and the big key; wax everywhere

anim.idle: polishes the key, candles flicker
anim.attack: key thrust; Candle Ring: spins the key over her head; Toll: walks to the bell, swings the key at it like a hammer
anim.phase3: six of her seven candles go out
anim.death: the last candle goes out; she kneels in the water and the bell cracks

warlord_ruhk.name: Warlord Ruhk
warlord_ruhk.title: of the Black Stag
warlord_ruhk.arena: the mine's deep gallery turned throne room: a 28 x 20 m hall with mine-cart rails crossing it (carts roll in phase 3), his war-tent and the Black Stag standard at the far end, two side tunnels (adds), braziers that a sapper's charge can knock over (fire patches)

phases.name: The Warlord
phases.notes: him and two bannerbearers (hollowhorn_warcaller stats at 0.6 hp) whose Rally must be interrupted; killing a bannerbearer drops a banner you can PICK UP (interact) for +15% damage 20 s

phases.name: The Sappers
phases.notes: sappers in the tunnels throw charges; a raider pack comes from each tunnel every 30 s

phases.name: The Black Stag
phases.notes: he mounts the Black Stag (a great antlered beast, creature body): charges on lines, carts on the rails, +30% damage (a real enrage phase with a visible tell)

stag_cleave.name: Stag Cleave
stag_cleave.counter: do not stack in front; the tank points him at a wall

war_drum.name: War Drum
war_drum.effect: he beats the drum on his back: every Hollowhorn in the hall +30% damage and immune to slows for 10 s, and HE heals 5%
war_drum.counter: interrupt; it is the fight's main interrupt

bannerbearers.name: Bannerbearers
bannerbearers.effect: two bannerbearers at the pull; each Rally (interruptible) buffs; a dropped banner is a pick-up buff for players
bannerbearers.counter: kill them first, take the banners

blast_charges.name: Blast Charges
blast_charges.effect: two sappers in the tunnel mouths plant charges near the players (3 s fuse, 3x fire, knockback 5 m, brazier knock-over)
blast_charges.counter: move; or kick the charge (interact) toward the raider pack

the_clan.name: The Clan
the_clan.effect: 3 raiders + 1 slinger from a tunnel every 30 s (phase 2 only)
the_clan.counter: area attacks at the tunnel mouth; the mouth is a chokepoint

stag_charge.name: Stag Charge
stag_charge.effect: mounted: charges the line for 3x + knockdown 2 s; hits a wall and the Stag is dazed 2.5 s (free damage on BOTH)
stag_charge.counter: sidestep; stand so the line ends in a wall

rail_carts.name: Rail Carts
rail_carts.effect: a cart rolls down one of the two rails: 2x + knockback; the rails are drawn on the floor so you always know where carts can be
rail_carts.counter: stay off the rails except to cross

last_charge_of_the_clan.name: Last Charge of the Clan
last_charge_of_the_clan.effect: +30% damage, +20% speed, interrupt-immune (the drum is gone: he is on the stag); the fight is now about charges and carts
last_charge_of_the_clan.counter: burn him; defensives on the charge

loot.notes: uniques: 'Ruhk's Antlered Crown' (head; attack power + the clan's rally as a proc) and 'Hide of the Black Stag' (chest; charge immunity)

proportions.head: 0.4, a black stag-skull helm with full antlers (1.2 m wide)

parts: a giant Hollowhorn in black-iron plate
a black stag-skull helm with a full rack of antlers
a war drum strapped to his back
a red cloak of stitched banners
phase 3: the Black Stag, a 2.4 m tall antlered beast with red eyes and iron shoes
look.silhouette: the antlers are the widest thing in the hall; on the stag, taller than anything you have fought

anim.idle: leans on the axe, the drum thuds once every few seconds
anim.attack: Cleave: a huge horizontal; War Drum: he turns his back and beats the drum (his back is open; a tell AND a punishment: you must interrupt from behind him)
anim.phase3: whistles, the Stag comes from the tent, he vaults on
anim.death: the Stag bolts; he falls to one knee, pulls off the helm, and falls

harrowmund.name: Harrowmund
harrowmund.title: the Sealed Lord
harrowmund.arena: PHASES 1-2: the sealed throne room, 26 m round, the seal (a great gold door-sigil) on the floor round the throne, twelve coffin-niches in the walls, four Gravesworn chanters channelling at the seal when you enter (killable; each one left alive makes phase 2 come 10% sooner). ARENA CHANGE at phase 3: the floor breaks and everyone falls into the Vault Below, a bigger hall 34 m across with a bone-river down the middle (a 3 m channel that slows 30% and ticks shadow), his true throne, and pillars that fall as the fight goes on.

phases.name: The Seal Holds
phases.notes: he is on the throne, bound by the seal: he cannot move, only reach 6 m and cast. The chanters try to free him; you must kill them while coffin knights come out of the niches. This phase ENDS when the chanters finish or die (not on hp); his hp is unchanged by it except what you deal

phases.name: Unsealed
phases.notes: he stands and walks; the crown of candles is the interrupt; the grave wave is the ring; the levy is the add rhythm

phases.name: The Vault Below
phases.notes: ARENA CHANGE: the floor drops; the bone-river hazard; pillars fall on a 20 s rhythm (a line telegraph each); the King's Due is the enrage-style big cast with a 2-minute clock on this phase (after it the Due is uninterruptible)

lance_of_the_crown.name: Lance of the Crown
lance_of_the_crown.effect: a bone lance down the line: 2.5x shadow + bleed; aimed at the player furthest away (it punishes staying at max range)
lance_of_the_crown.counter: sidestep; ranged players stand at 8-10 m not 15

the_four_chanters.name: The Four Chanters
the_four_chanters.effect: four gravesworn_chanters at the four seal points, each channelling 'Open the Door' at 60 s; each kill removes 25% of the seal's progress bar; they are immune to interrupts for the first 10 s (the Keepers' ward), then interruptible: an interrupt sets that chanter back 15 s
the_four_chanters.counter: kill them in order; interrupts buy time; the coffin knights are the distraction

coffin_knights.name: Coffin Knights
coffin_knights.effect: one ossuary_knight steps out of a niche every 25 s in phase 1 (they glow 2 s before)
coffin_knights.counter: the tank picks them up; kill them between chanters

crown_of_candles.name: Crown of Candles
crown_of_candles.effect: his crown lights: every player takes 3x shadow and is feared 2 s (runs away) unless they are within 3 m of a lit sconce (the hall has four); on finish he also heals 5%
crown_of_candles.counter: interrupt; or everyone at a sconce

grave_wave.name: Grave Wave
grave_wave.effect: a ring expands from him at 5 m/s: 2x shadow + knockdown 1.5 s; safe INSIDE 2 m (hug him) or behind a pillar/coffin
grave_wave.counter: hug or take cover; melee hug, ranged pillar

the_levy.name: The Levy
the_levy.effect: raises 4 barrow husks + 1 shroudmother (the shroudmother must die first or the husks keep coming back)
the_levy.counter: interrupt the Levy if the last adds are not dead yet; shroudmother first

bone_river.name: Bone River
bone_river.effect: the channel down the vault: standing in it slows 30% and ticks 2% hp/s shadow; it widens by 1 m every 30 s of phase 3
bone_river.counter: cross it fast; the fight shrinks, which is the soft timer

falling_pillars.name: Falling Pillars
falling_pillars.effect: a pillar falls along the line: 3x + knockdown 2 s; the fallen pillar STAYS as cover for Grave Wave and Lance (it blocks line of sight)

the_kings_due.name: The King's Due
the_kings_due.effect: a 6 s cast: 5x shadow to everyone not behind cover and every husk corpse rises; after 120 s in phase 3 it becomes UNINTERRUPTIBLE (the enrage) and the cooldown drops to 15 s
the_kings_due.counter: interrupt it; use fallen pillars as cover when you cannot; kill him before the 2-minute clock

loot.notes: uniques: 'The Sealed Crown' (head; shadow resist, fear immunity) and 'Harrowmund's Seal' (ring; 'sealed' proc that locks an enemy's cast); first kill per difficulty: a guaranteed unique and the Veteran unlock (ruling 7)

proportions.torso: 1.3 in a great robe over black plate
proportions.head: 0.45, a crown of twelve candles on a skull
proportions.arms: 1.1, one holds a 2 m bone sceptre

parts: a giant skeletal king in black plate under a gold-threaded robe
a crown of twelve candles (lit one by one through the fight: 4 in phase 1, 8 in phase 2, 12 in phase 3)
a bone sceptre with the sealed-door sigil
gold chains from the seal still on his wrists in phase 1 (they snap at phase 2)
a cloak of ledger pages and banners
blue-white flame in the eye sockets, a crack down the skull
phase 3: the robe burns away to the plate, the candles are all lit, the sceptre glows
look.silhouette: the twelve-candle crown over a seated giant; standing, the sceptre is taller than a player

anim.idle: (seated) drums the sceptre on the throne arm; (standing) a slow walk, the robe drags
anim.attack: Sealed Strike: backhand; Lance: points the sceptre; Crown: raises both arms, candles flare; Wave: slams the sceptre; Due: lifts the sceptre in both hands, head back, the room darkens
anim.phase2: stands, the chains snap, the seal cracks
anim.phase3: the floor breaks, he falls through first, you land round him
anim.death: the candles go out one by one over 4 s; he sits back on the throne and goes still; the crown rolls off

spawnTables._doc: Spawn tables per zone/dungeon. `packs` are weighted compositions the zone's spawn markers roll from (a marker tagged `pack` rolls here; `patrol` markers roll from `patrols`; `swarm` markers from `swarms` (swarm-role types); `perch`/`burrow`/`log` markers only accept types whose ai uses them). Compositions list `type:count` (count may be [min,max]). `champion` is the chance a rolled pack becomes a champion pack. `density` is packs per 100 m of main path, for the zone editor's checks. `levelBand` is the zone's monster level; a monster's `levelRange` must OVERLAP it (the sim spawns the monster at the zone level clamped into its own range; a pack with `minLevel` only rolls on markers at or past that level); tests/bestiary.test.js. `boss` names the dungeon's boss id in `bosses`.

packs.note: the warband's scouts at the shore's far end only (markers tagged 'warband')
the first caster, on a rock, near the tidecaves mouth

saltgrass_shore.notes: Level 1 is crabs alone. Snappers from 1 but they flank, which is the level-2 lesson. The first warband pack stands at the beach gate as a story beat.

tidecaves.notes: Floor 1: crabs and the first husks. Floor 2: shellbacks (the magic-vs-armour lesson) and brinewives with husks (the interrupt lesson). Boss room is a tide pool.

windmill_fields.notes: The zone where you meet a SWARM (rats), an ARCHER (slinger) and a brute that comes from underneath. Rat swarms sit by every barn.

packs.note: looters who got in first, near the stair

mill_cellars.notes: Short dungeon: persistent ground (Bloom), armour-shred (Bore), swarms in tight rooms. The boss is the mill itself.

thornwood.notes: The flanking zone: wolves circle, cutthroats go behind you. Charge lines from boars. Bramblewights are bushes until you are next to them.

thornwood_hollow.notes: Egg sacs are spawner props (see spiderling.ai). Floor 2 pinches are trapdoors. The boss is the brood mother.

patrols.note: THE flee-to-call test: patrols are 35-50 m apart along the road so a fleeing warcaller usually has somewhere to go

kings_road.notes: The full warband roster: this zone teaches the SHAMAN (bonechanter) and the LEADER (warcaller). The road is a chain of toll camps.

elderglade.notes: Storm and frost damage arrive; the Unfinished Chorus is the interrupt exam; the glade warden's ring telegraph. Nothing here flanks: the elderkin fight in formation.

old_barrow.notes: The Restless: husks that get back up, Gravecandle auras, the Shroudmother to kill first. Floor 1 shows the diggers' camp so the Gravesworn are introduced as people before they are a cult.

elder_roots.notes: Pulls (Drag) and column-piercing charges (Bore Through): do not stand in a line. The boss is the last moon-priestess.

packs.note: a digger party crossing the fen toward the crypt

mirefen.notes: Poison that stacks and persists; the mudwitch is the healer to kill; marsh lights charm you into the pools. Boardwalks are the safe ground.

mire_crypt.notes: The Gravesworn's first real dungeon: 'Open the Door' channels at every door marker; keeper + chanter is the interrupt ORDER puzzle. Sludge husks burst.

highcairn_pass.notes: Flyers in earnest (drakes that land, a kite that never does), surprise openers (lynx), chain charges (rams), the mauler you kite instead of tank.

packs.note: the warband keeps them chained; markers tagged 'drake_post'

redcliff_heights.notes: The warband camp: every role at once, big packs, patrols that answer flee-calls. The sapper's area denial. Tents are destructible props that drop loot.

warband_mine.notes: Warband and Gravesworn side by side (they are allies here, not yet). Blast charges at chokepoints; a dug-up sentinel guards the deep gallery. Ruhk at the bottom.

sunken_ruins.notes: Wall-walking shades, push/pull wardens, cross telegraphs. The Gravesworn have their leader here.

gravewatch_hills.notes: Everything the Restless have, with the Gravesworn marching among them. Reeves ride off to bring the next cairn's pack.

deep_catacomb.notes: The final exam. Floor 3 is the throne approach: the Gravesworn's last chanters open the seal while you fight. Harrowmund at the bottom.
